text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I... won?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
You did it, Taishiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: (The crowd is so loud.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (I'm so... tired.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Despite winning the Derby, it seems
Narita
Taishin completely exhausted
herself battling
against her rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, nothing's too out of the ordinary.
It looks
like she just overexerted herself.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
With a little rest, she should regain

consciousness—oh, looks like I spoke
too soon.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Was I asleep?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Stop freaking out...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: How's your body feel? Are you dizzy?
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Oh. No, I'm fine. Thanks.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's good, then. Make sure you take it
easy and
rest up.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Okay...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
After the doctor leaves, a whirlwind
blows into
the room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Taishiiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Guh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin, Taishin, Taishin! Y-y-you collasped! I can't believe you collaaasped!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, Taishin? What did the
doctor
say?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah—I'm fine. You guys worry
too much.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad... I assume you're still
planning to
run in the Kikuka Sho, then?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Duh. Was there any doubt?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Good. There's something you should
know, then.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Next time, it's my turn.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Hayahide's not playing around!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And I'm... I'm not gonna back down in
the Kikuka
Sho either, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: It sucks really bad that you stole the Derby from me, and I'm so, sooo mad!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna turn this anger into
energy! And I'm
gonna use it to run as
fast as lightning down the
track!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! The Kikuka Sho will be miiiiine!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure. Just barge in here, make some
grand
declarations, and leave...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (For some reason...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (They look almost... radiant.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I told you I'm fine! Come on, let's go
already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Listen up—you'd better not go easy on
me during
training tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I catch you holding back on me, I'm
gonna
launch you into another galaxy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho's gonna be mine!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The finale of the Triple Crown tour, the
Kikuka
Sho, awaits us next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин reaffirms her dedication to
keep
pushing on, so she can surpass her
two rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: All that matters is that I win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep winning, then one
day...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
